analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (69,955 KRW) vs SMA5 (68,271 KRW) / SMA20 (87,644 KRW) / SMA50 (99,637 KRW): short-term trend above, medium-to-long-term trend below
· Significantly lower position relative to SMA100 (127,872 KRW) / SMA200 (112,467 KRW): medium-to-long-term trend weakening
· 52-week position (22.2%): approaching historical low range
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (27.1→34.7): attempting to exit oversold territory, preparing to enter neutral zone
· MACD histogram trajectory (-4275.3736→-1663.3716): weakness persists but improvement confirmed
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band 87,644 KRW): consolidating near the middle band, band width is wide at 87.49%
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support (68,045 KRW): decline from 5-day high 74,365 KRW, above 20-day low 61,145 KRW
· Swing Resistance (80,380 KRW): approximately 14.8% upside from current price
· 5-day / 20-day High-Low Pattern: Higher Low pattern forming, 5-day low 61,145 KRW = 20-day low 61,145 KRW
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.88x): subdued volume compared to 5-day average, reduced confidence in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis: Accumulation phase, maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to lack of direction and subdued buying pressure
